title: isVocabularyWord
summary: Test whether words are in a wordEmbedding or wordEncoding vocabulary.

gpu_support.notes: `isVocabularyWord` is a host vocabulary lookup and has no provider kernel.

description: `isVocabularyWord(emb, words)` and `isVocabularyWord(enc, words)` return logical masks for vocabulary membership.
behaviors: The first input must be a RunMat `wordEmbedding` or `wordEncoding` compatibility object.
`words` may be a string scalar, string array, character vector, character matrix, or cell array of scalar text.

The output logical array preserves the input word container shape for string arrays and cell arrays. A character vector returns a scalar 1-by-1 logical array; a character matrix returns one row per input row.

faqs.question: Does this work for both embeddings and encodings?
faqs.answer: Yes. RunMat supports `wordEmbedding` objects from `fastTextWordEmbedding`, `readWordEmbedding`, or `trainWordEmbedding`, and `wordEncoding` objects from `wordEncoding`.

faqs.question: Does `isVocabularyWord` execute on the GPU?
faqs.answer: No. It is a host vocabulary lookup.

example.input:
tf = isVocabularyWord(emb, words)
tf = isVocabularyWord(enc, words)
tf = isVocabularyWord(___, 'IgnoreCase', true)

gpu_residency: `isVocabularyWord` reads host text/model metadata and returns a CPU logical array.
